cw_sr_partner_scan = {
# IMPERIA COLD WAR — GC emergency space quarantine.
if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = cw_sr_emergency_disabled } }

if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = cw_sr_emergency_disabled } is_ai = no IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes has_country_flag = cw_sr_initialized }
set_variable = { cw_sr_partner_count = 0 }
set_temp_variable = { cw_sr_crew_found = 0 }
set_temp_variable = { cw_sr_crew_first = 0 }
set_temp_variable = { cw_sr_crew_next = 0 }
every_country = { limit = { exists = yes is_ai = no NOT = { tag = PREV } NOT = { has_war_with = PREV } }
add_to_variable = { PREV.cw_sr_partner_count = 1 }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cw_sr_crew_first = 0 } }
set_temp_variable = { PREV.cw_sr_crew_first = THIS.id }
}
if = { limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cw_sr_crew_found = 1 } check_variable = { PREV.cw_sr_crew_next = 0 } }
set_temp_variable = { PREV.cw_sr_crew_next = THIS.id }
}
if = { limit = { check_variable = { THIS.id = PREV.cw_sr_crew_candidate } }
set_temp_variable = { PREV.cw_sr_crew_found = 1 }
}
}
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cw_sr_crew_next = 0 } }
set_temp_variable = { cw_sr_crew_next = cw_sr_crew_first }
}
set_variable = { cw_sr_partner_checked_day = global.num_days }
set_country_flag = cw_sr_partner_catalogue_cached
}
}
}
